newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco products diffs static as prices sink.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco products diffs static as prices sink.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent oil products prices slid Wednesday as futures prices failed at resistance levels and turned tail, though regional differentials were unchanged.
"I think the basis will tread water today," said one Kansas City trader, referring to the regional price differentials.

Physical market activity is expected to slow due to the volatility of outright prices caused by the futures market move. Heating oil futures, marker for Midco diesel and jet, swung between 74.40 cents a gallon and 71.30 during the morning and stood at 71.65 at 1130 CDT.
Chicago low sulphur diesel for October delivery was holding around three cents under front-month November heating oil futures, with high sulphur 5.75 cents under, traders said.
Chicago unleaded gasoline remained 1.25/1.0 cent under for all October delivery, with premium 2.75 cents higher.
Group Three unleaded was bid 1.25/offered 1.0 cent under for prompt and later October deliveries, with premium steady at 3.0 cents higher.
